speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned presenting with feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting; have you noticed any abdominal distension or blood in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with Midgut Volvulus.

The presence of bilious vomiting in a newborn, especially with a family history of pyloric stenosis, is a surgical emergency; please prepare for an urgent abdominal X-ray and immediate surgical consultation.
